history.overview: The Chamber of Storms channels lightning‑aligned Discord energy to energize planar conduits and destabilize rift barriers.

timeline.name: Storm Chamber Constructed
timeline.description: Riftseekers built the chamber to harness elemental lightning and wind.

timeline.name: Discord Storm Infusion
timeline.description: Discord energy was bound to crystalline towers, amplifying atmospheric instability.

timeline.name: Muramite Storm Assaults
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to weaponize the chamber’s lightning.

timeline.name: Tempest Rites
timeline.description: Riftseekers conducted rituals that energized planar conduits and disrupted rift barriers.
